# American Academy of Appellate Lawyers

> A premier professional association for appellate law specialists offering membership, continuing legal education, resources, and recognition of excellence in appellate practice.

The Academy serves as a hub for appellate lawyers to connect, learn, and advance the field through bi-annual meetings, task forces, and curated resources. Founded in 1990, it maintains rigorous fellowship criteria and recognizes outstanding contributions to appellate jurisprudence through awards like the prestigious Eisenberg Prize.

## About the Academy

- [American Academy of Appellate Lawyers](https://www.appellateacademy.org): Homepage for the American Academy of Appellate Lawyers professional association
- [About The Academy](https://www.appellateacademy.org/about-the-academy): About the Academy: membership criteria, board structure, and fellowship requirements
- [Officers & Directors](https://www.appellateacademy.org/about-the-academy/officers-directors): Current officers and directors of the American Academy of Appellate Lawyers
- [History of AAAL](https://www.appellateacademy.org/about-the-academy/history-of-aaal): Historical timeline of the Academy from 1990 founding through milestones

## Membership & Events

- [Find an Appellate Lawyer](https://www.appellateacademy.org/find-an-appellate-lawyer): Directory and information about finding appellate lawyers and legal specialists
- [Meetings](https://www.appellateacademy.org/meetings): Bi-annual meetings and CLE learning events for Academy Fellows
- [Awards](https://www.appellateacademy.org/about-the-academy/awards): Eisenberg Prize and awards recognizing appellate practice publications

- [Resources](https://www.appellateacademy.org/resources): Resources hub including amicus briefs and external legal resources
